name: White-label appointment revenue recovery
canonical_role: Outcome-linked experiment lane distributed through healthcare agencies and adjacent partners
buyer: Healthcare marketing agencies and appointment-oriented technology partners

scope: one reminder or no-show rescue flow
pilot.acceptance_metric: Recovered bookings, callbacks, or confirmations from missed demand

operating_constraints: No protected health information until contracts, security, and compliance gates are real
kill_conditions: Zero paid pilots after 100 qualified first touches and the full declared sequence
No clear ROI inside 14 to 30 days
Support burden remains high after templating
Compliance or integration complexity destroys margin

name: Agency/MSP white-label AI workflow backend
canonical_role: Primary distribution and fulfillment model across multiple AI workflow lanes
buyer: Agencies, MSPs, consultancies, platform partners, and implementation firms

pilot.acceptance_metric: Written acceptance of the bounded workflow plus measured delivery economics

pricing_note: The Canon provides a serious-pilot range of USD 500 to USD 5,000. Exact pricing requires live buyer evidence and scope.

expansion.recurring_model: QA, monitoring, tuning, and white-label fulfillment retainer

operating_constraints: Measure owner minutes and gross margin
kill_conditions: No paid pilot after 100 live-validated unique organizations
Repeated demand is subcontracting-only with no recurring path
Owner time exceeds declared delivery ceiling
Gross margin is not positive after real costs

name: Agency multi-site revenue-path assurance
buyer: Marketing agencies, web agencies, and firms managing multiple client websites

scope: up to two low-risk reversible repairs per site
pilot.acceptance_metric: Accepted evidence pack and completed bounded repairs

expansion.recurring_model: Per-site monitoring, repair credits, and white-label reporting

operating_constraints: No credential use before written scope and payment
kill_conditions: No paid pilot after a valid 100-organization agency experiment
False positives or inaccessible CMSs make delivery unreliable
Monitoring does not convert after accepted delivery
Founder time cannot be reduced through templates and automation
